settings.heading: Korean beauty, step by step, for island skin
settings.text: Korean beauty is a way of caring for skin, not a shelf of products. Gentle ingredients, thin layers, and the habit of returning to it every day.

settings.heading: Why it suits island skin
settings.text: It was built for skin that lives with heat and humidity, which is exactly what island skin does. Sun, salt and air conditioning wear the barrier down. The routine builds it back.

settings.heading: The routine
settings.text: Morning and evening, in this order. Thin layers, patted in, a few seconds between each.

settings.name: Cleanse
settings.text: A Korean routine begins clean. A low-foam cleanser lifts sunscreen, salt and the whole day without stripping the oils your skin makes for itself, which is what keeps it from going tight and then oily.

settings.name: Tone
settings.text: A toner here is nothing like the alcohol splash you remember. It is a thin layer of water and calming plant extracts that puts moisture back and opens the way for everything after it.

settings.name: Treat
settings.text: The serum is where the routine does its real work. Small molecules, high concentration, one job: to hydrate, to brighten, or to calm. On island skin, hydration comes first.

settings.name: Moisturise
settings.text: A cream seals everything in and supports the barrier that sun, salt and air conditioning wear down. Light in the morning, richer at night.

settings.name: Protect
settings.text: Sunscreen every morning, rain or shine, indoors or out. It is the one step that decides how your skin looks in ten years, and Korean formulas make it a pleasure to wear.

settings.heading: Begin with three steps, not five
settings.text: Cleanse, tone, protect. Do that for a month, then add the serum and the cream when it feels natural.

settings.heading: The real formula, or nothing
settings.text:
A lot of Korean beauty in Mauritius arrives in a suitcase, or through a reseller who cannot say where it was kept, for how long, or whether it is the real thing.

Moana Beauté exists to change that. On every product you see the full ingredient list, so you can check it against the brand's own. And when you have a question, write to us.
